verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a SaaS merchant-of-record platform, so choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents data residency or region selection. Mentions of accepting payments from 135+ countries and local currencies concern sales reach, not where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
